cohort: The study included 897 preterm infants born between 24 + 0/7 and 30 + 6/7 weeks of gestational age in Germany, from 2010 to 2020.
finding: The DIGIROP-Birth calculator demonstrated good predictive power for ROP requiring treatment in the studied population, with an AUC of 0.860.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was identified as a significant peri- and postnatal risk factor for ROP.
